_comment: journal-this per-operator config. Written by the setup interview to ~/.config/journal-this/config.json. This template documents every field. Copy it, fill it in, or just run the skill once and let the setup interview create it for you.
voice_source: ~/path/to/your/existing/journal/  (folder path, GitHub repo URL, or null if you have no samples yet)

destination._subdir_note: subdir has no trailing slash; use "" for repo root. Disk configs ignore the git fields.

_commit_trailer_note: github only — string, or null for no trailer. Disk configs use null (there is no commit).
